description.p: Tmiix is a terminal with built-in tmux, SSH, and snippets support. Tmiix manages local and remote tmux sessions in a beautiful, intuitive, and fast graphical user interface.

ul.li: Manage tmux sessions on local and SSH servers
Manage shell snippets to run on local and SSH servers
Paste clipboard image directly into AI coding agent on SSH servers
UI to upload files to SSH servers
Keyboard shortcuts to quickly switch sessions
Fully customizable

screenshot.caption: Active tmux session with tabs and split panes

ul.li: Add snippets management with quick run and edit
Autocomplete snippets in command palette
Support copying terminal text selection
Detect tmux sessions started inside SSH shell tabs
Resizable sidebar with persistence
Improve session picker focus and reconnect handling
Support auto-connect, reconnect on resume, and file drag-and-drop upload for SSH
Add tab context menu, improve drag-and-drop, and fix manual reconnect
Add connection context menu, confirmation dialog for removing server, and upload files command
Various UI fixes, tweaks, and improved fuzzy search
Integrate with ssh-agent
Support kill-session command and open tmux session here command
Enable tmux native context menu
Fix autocomplete in session palette and various UI improvements
Fix detecting tmux path on macOS
Prevent terminal text overflow

description.p: Initial release with local and remote tmux session management
